services.name: Live on Air Balloon Ride
services.desc: The Live On Air Balloon Ride offers a thrilling new perspective of Niagara Falls, New York, lifting you high above the surrounding area for sweeping panoramic views. Take in the Niagara River, Niagara Falls State Park, cityscape, and the Falls from above for a memorable sightseeing and photo experience. Imagine floating 400 feet above the Earth, suspended in the sky by the world’s largest tethered helium balloon. Below you, the mighty Niagara Falls roars, mist rising like breath from the lungs of the Earth. services.name: Rainbow Air Helicopter tour
services.desc: Rainbow Air Helicopter Tours offers an unforgettable aerial adventure over Niagara Falls from the U.S. side. Soar above the Niagara River and take in breathtaking views of the American, Bridal Veil, and Horseshoe Falls, along with the surrounding gorge and landmarks, from a spectacular perspective high above the Falls. Experience the most awe-inspiring panorama of Niagara Falls simply by taking a Rainbow Air helicopter ride and gazing out of the window. Rainbow Air has been offering helicopter tours of the American side of the Niagara region since 1995. Aside from tours, Rainbow Air also offers charter services and aerial weddings.
